newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Robotics, Nortel in joint development deal.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Robotics, Nortel in joint development deal.

text.p: U.S. Robotics Corp and Northern Telecom Ltd said Tuesday they entered into an agreement to jointly develop digital wireless computer access products.
The two said the agreement was based on the growing need among professionals to access electronic mail, the Internet and other computer applications via wireless phone.
Plans call for development of equipment and software to connect wireless calls to networks such as the Internet or company Intranets.
The companies said the products will work with both code division multiple access (CDMA) and time division multiple access (TDMA) wireless phone technologies.
U.S. Robotics provides products and systems that provide access to information. Nortel works with customers worldwide to design, build, and integrate digital networks.
